reviews.text:
Horrible experience. Avoid at all cost if possible. They bring you a bill before even examining your pet. They get defensive when you ask why certain tests are needed. They ordered an X-ray for my dog which on its own is already $400 and said they have to send it to a specialist to review which is another $300. Isn’t this place literally called “Miami veterinary specialist”? I asked if they can do the X-ray and for the doctor caring for my dog to interpret the images and if in doubt or there is something concerning to send it to the specialist after but no, they won’t work with you. They just want your money.

And a blonde middle age woman who obviously is very unhappy with her job or life or honestly both came in to give us our quote and was so disrespectful and unprofessional. When we questioned why certain tests were being performed she did literally did an eye roll and slammed the door walking away with no response. The doctor was very nice and caring (Dr. Ivan) but not even the great care from the doctor can make me change my mind about his staff and the attitude. Left such a bad taste. Please do yourself a favor and pick absolutely anywhere else to bring your loved pet. Unless you want to waste money on unnecessary care, then sure come here.
A highly professional clinic
The best place to take a dog to. They saved my dogs life !!! Honest Vets so so glad o took our Stella here.
Very good attention to my puppy from Dr. Anderson and assistant Harol..

I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the lack of ethics, financial transparency, and poor treatment at this clinic. I chose this hospital based on its high Google reviews and a referral from Banfield for an urgent endoscopy to remove a foreign body.
While the first veterinarian Ivan Perez who saw us was professional and explained the 4-hour delay for an ultrasound—which We accepted out of trust—everything went downhill from there. After paying the bill they presented to me, I was blindsided at the reception desk by the manager Deysi Figueroa (Client Service Manager) after 5 hours wait, who demanded an unannounced balance of $538.07??
When I asked for an explanation, the manager treated me in a very unethical and hostile manner. The manager showed me a handwritten note with the balance without prior billing after I demanded it.
She claimed the fee was for a 'specialist consultation with the surgeon, In reality, this "consultation" was just the surgeon speaking to me for less than three minutes in a public hallway and then received a quote. My dog ​​was never properly examined by her with me in a private room, which was a completely unfair and different treatment compared to other clients. Even my Banfield vet called during our wait and was shocked to hear they wanted to delay the urgent procedure for days until Thursday 17 September
Because of this abusive billing, the lack of empathy, and the manager's terrible attitude, I lost all trust, took my dog, and left. They wasted my money, my time, and left my pet untreated. Look out for unexpected charges and unprofessional staff."

I am extremely disappointed and frustrated by the lack of ethics, lack of financial transparency and poor treatment received at this clinic. I chose this hospital based on its excellent Google reviews and a recommendation from Banfield for an urgent endoscopy to remove a foreign body.
While the first veterinarian who saw us, Ivan Perez, was professional and explained the four-hour wait for an ultrasound—something I accepted out of trust—the situation deteriorated drastically from that point on. After paying the bill they presented to me, and after a five-hour wait, the manager, Deysi Figueroa (Customer Service Manager), surprised me at reception demanding payment of an outstanding balance of $538.07, which I hadn't been informed about beforehand.

When I asked for an explanation, the manager treated me in a hostile and unethical manner. Only after I insisted did she show me a handwritten note with the amount owed, without having presented me with a formal invoice beforehand.

She claimed the charge was for a "specialized consultation with the surgeon"; however, this "consultation" simply consisted of the surgeon speaking to me for less than three minutes in a public hallway, after which I was given a quote. They never properly examined my dog ​​in a private room with me present, which was completely unfair and different from the treatment other clients received. Even my veterinarian in Banfield called while we were waiting and was outraged to learn they intended to postpone the urgent procedure for several days, until Thursday, September 17th.
Because of this exorbitant charge, the lack of empathy, and the manager's terrible attitude, I lost all confidence: I took my dog ​​and left. They wasted my money and my time, and left my pet without treatment. Beware of unexpected charges and unprofessional staff.

Dr Anderson was absolutely wonderful with my cat when she had an emergency at 2am on a weekend! Nurse Keilyn was very sweet and patient and answered all of my questions. They took care of us and made me feel at ease! I would recommend them for any emergency needs!

I’m extremely disappointed with my experience here. I brought my dog in around 10 PM for a broken nail, something relatively simple, and ended up being at the vet for FOUR HOURS, until around 2 AM.

It took approximately an hour and a half just for us to initially be seen. During that time, I watched multiple patients who arrived after us be attended to. Later, there was an emergency surgery, which I completely understand takes priority. I would never expect my dog’s broken nail to come before an animal experiencing a life-threatening emergency.

However, my issue is the complete lack of communication and the excessive amount of time we were left waiting. Four hours for a broken nail, with little to no updates about what was happening or how much longer we could expect to wait, is unacceptable. If there are going to be major delays, pet owners should at least be kept informed instead of being left sitting for hours wondering what is going on.

I understand that emergency veterinary hospitals can be unpredictable, but communication and consideration for people’s time still matter. This experience could have been handled so much better with simple updates and transparency.

This is my second time here. Staff is terrible. Especially front desk. The vet told me he was too busy to come talk to me so instead sent a vet tech with a bill 😂😂 they just slap things on the bill for fun. Don’t come here. Absolutely horrible experience. The front staff were incredibly rude—the girl with red hair literally rolled her eyes at me while I was speaking, and the attitude from the staff member during checkout was just as bad. The 2 girls in the front were more concerned about their puppy that was hanging out behind the counter then anything else. What made it worse was that there weren’t any other patients there.

The vet spent maybe 30 seconds with my dog, called him a “mush,” said he needed X- rays, and then I was handed an estimate for X-rays, sedation, blood work, etc. I tried to ask if sedation was actually necessary. My dog is 130 lbs, highly command-trained and bite-trained, and was completely under control.  Sedating a dog that size also means I’m responsible for getting a sedated 130 lb dog back into my car. My concern was barely entertained. After asking to speak with the vet about sedation, I was told the vet was too busy to talk to me, so I waited there another 30 minutes after already waiting for an hour.

I declined the blood work, which I was told was required for NSAIDs, did not sign the treatment estimate, asked for my dog back, and left. They STILL charged me for the roughly 30 second interaction with the vet.

I have no problem paying for necessary veterinary care. I have a problem with unnecessary attitude, terrible communication, and being handed a laundry list of charges.

They handle pet emergencies with professionalism and care. Very communicative, specialists on hand, 24/7 care. This is a superior animal hospital. Munchie is now doing well and on the road to recovery🐾
Great service. Specially for being open late night.

I visited this veterinary clinic to have my Golden Retriever treated and received excellent service, especially very professional attention from Dr. Anderson and his assistant Harold. I highly recommend them.

We are so grateful to Dr. Anderson and his staff, Harold and Jacqueline. They treated my cat, Joy, with so much love and care, attending to her quickly for an allergic reaction to the vaccine. We are so relieved and satisfied with the care they provided. I recommend them 100%.
Absolutely exceptional work! Everyone was so unbelievably nice and professional and they know what they’re doing! Don’t know what I’d do without great people like this.

I had an excellent experience tonight at Miami Veterinary Specialists. I brought my dog, Shyla, in after she may have swallowed a piece of a toy, and everyone treated us with extraordinary kindness, professionalism, and compassion.

Dr. Anderson was wonderful. He was also the doctor who cared for Shyla when I brought her here after our serious car accident earlier this year. During both visits, he was genuinely caring, patient, and thorough, with excellent “bedside” manner. The nurses who assisted us tonight, Harold and Yanitza, were equally kind, attentive, and compassionate.

From the moment we arrived, I felt that Shyla was in capable hands and that everyone truly cared about her well-being. Emergency veterinary visits are incredibly stressful, but the team made the experience as reassuring and comfortable as possible. I am very grateful to Dr. Anderson, Harold, Yanitza, and the entire MVS team for the exceptional care they provided Shyla. I highly recommend them.

I’m so grateful for the amazing care my pet received here during an emergency\. The staff was kind, compassionate, and professional, and they made a very stressful situation much easier\. Thank you Dr. Ben Anderson and nurse Harold for treating my pet with such care\! 🐾❤️ Highly recommend\! …

Great experience from start to finish.Dr Ben Anderson and Harold (nurse) were very knowledgeable, patient, and gentle with my dog. The staff was friendly and explained everything clearly. Highly recommend!”

If there was less than one star i would give it. This place is a total rip off. They take advantage of you coming in distress due to your sick dog and had us sign an estimate of 20 items of outrageously expensive tests and medicines which you have to pay in advance for them to treat the dog.  We Were charged a total of $3000 ( after protesting several items on the final bill) for a 2 night stay of our 20 pound dog with gastritis.
I'm so happy with how they treated my beautiful girl, everything went perfectly, thank you 🙂 …

Been here twice, both times have had to wait over 7 hours. My first experience here wasn't horrible due purely to the fact that I had my dog with me the entire wait time but the second time I came, unfortunately i was there a total of 10+ hours. Arrived at around 11:30PM with my 15 year old blind chihuahua who was vomiting white foam and very bloated after eating. They took him back pretty quick and told me they were going to take vitals. Vet eventually came and spoke to me about an hour later and told me that they were going to run blood work and gave me a quote for blood work and a potential xray. all very expensive but i was expecting this due to it being an emergency room. the vet tending to us was very kind and so was the girl at the front desk, all the other techs and nurses were extremely rude and kept denying any questions i had or any of my requests to see my dog after being there 7 hours. I kept asking to see my dog and i kept being told that they were still doing blood work or that they were doing the xray. i didnt get my dog back with me till 6am. they hadnt treated him AT ALL. only ran tests which came back as they said “completely obstructed” and that he needed emergency surgery. I was there past their shift change, so any questions i had were met with “the day doctor wants to conduct his own physical exam so we have to do everything again.” at this point i was being given a quote for a 4 day hospitalization, and surgeon consult after they told me my dog was anemic and had high white blood cell count. I kept asking if there was possibility for IV treatment and they kept denying, trying to persuade me into just agreeing to the quote saying that his obstruction would not clear without surgery. saying he had a confirmed foreign body… eventually i left around 9AM and took him to our regular vet where they had him on a 8 hour IV which made him poop, and then they did an xray next morning and said he was completely clear. no obstruction. MVS was trying to have me agree to a ridiculous quote, kept me there for over 10 hours, and didn't even treat my dog!! just ran tests! completely ridiculous, will not be coming here again.
They are very professional and there are some very good doctors.
Dr. Anderson, Maria and the rest of the wonderful staff were a tremendous help in making sure our kitty gets the help she needed in a quick and easy manner. 10/10 would recommend!!
Dr. Anderson handled my kittens so well!! So glad to have him to save the day. Shoutout to Maria as well

BEWARE!!!!! IF YOU LOVE YOUR PET, I AM WARNING YOU, THIS PLACE ONLY CARES ABOUT $$$$ NOT YOUR  BELOVED PET.
THEY COLLECT UP FRONT OR THEY WILL NOT SEE YOUR PET!!! WHEN YOU DO PAY YOU ARE JUST A NUMBER!
The MANAGER Does not return phone calls. I called several times and left messages only to get a call 23days later!!!!  You would think initial exam $500 would include checking your pets teeth ESPECIALLY if my complaint was loss of weight. ABSOLUTELY NOT, and the report said all normal! They lie!!!!!  I Decided to check myself and he has a broken tooth!! Poor baby. He was put in holding cage several days and they didn’t even take the time to help him but they did charge $3500. This place is pathetic. To think how many people they have robbed blind of their money. This place makes me sick to my stomach. MY FIRST MISTAKE WAS NOT CHECKING REVIEWS BEFORE TAKING MY PET TO THIS BOGUS PET CLINIC. ZERO stars is what this GREEDY NON PROFESSIONAL suck you financially dry pet factory is worth.
BEWARE!!!!! I waited days/hours, no return phone calls, no answers, and charge more MONEY $$$$$$$$$ for Same tests and NO results. A specialist that was so confused, tired, overwhelmed, she didn’t even know what my pet was there for!!!!! She didn’t read the medical report before addressing me in the waiting room (no private room) at 10pm. Only to tell me, my pet needed to stay for more tests!!!! My pet waited all weekend to be seen Monday. Waited allllllll day Monday and was not seen till I insisted on taking him home at 9pm!!!! The  specialist spoke to me at 10pm! They never saw him so her RESPONSE we need more tests so he needs to stay and more $$$$. They wanted to charge me more money for their lack of time management. They were so busy taking in so many pets they don’t  give pets proper treatment. So their EXCUSE Is to keep your pet longer due to their lack of timing for more money.  THEY COLLECT YOUR MONEY UP FRONT THEN YOUR PET IS JUST A NUMBER put in a cage and sits in the back with cheap food not even good quality food. They said my pet ate!!! No he did not I checked in on him and his food was dry/stale. He was so thin! Still they didn’t check his teeth!! My pet is the sweetest yet no one cared to find out why he was sick. As for the other pets, sad display of neglected cages. I felt sad for the animals in there. I received a CALL BACK 23 days later for a SICK pet, Only to tell me NO ANSWERS, he  needs more tests! That’s what $3,500 gets you here.  Several other people were complaining in waiting room about all the monies they were charged and no answers.  I knew I had made the wrong choice when I heard all the disgruntled customers but it was too late. SWINDLERS!!! all appearance NO CARE NO LOVE NO COMPASSION. I regret ever have taken my beloved pet to this disgraceful place. This place should be closed down! All that money and nothing for it!
He passed away and I am heart broken. I will never forgive myself for taking him here. Even when you pay they don’t care No empathy no compassion. All
About $$$$$$$$$ I feel for the people who don’t take my review to heart. I miss my furball every single day.

Do your homework before you trust your beloved pet to this place. Dr. Anderson is rude and should get himself another profession.  Before. you pay thousands (I paid $11,500.00 after being handed a $22,000.00 estimate within 48 hours,) I don’t have a pet .  There’s much better choices. I have nothing to lose anymore I already did. Don’t be sorry like I am
Although I didn’t go there by choice but recommend by the emergency clinic. I wish I would’ve known better.

Forever grateful to Miami Veterinary Specialists for taking such incredible care of our Goose. ❤️🐾

A special thank you to Dr. Natalia Andrade, Maddy, and every staff member who cared for him during such a scary time. Goose needed emergency surgery after a mango seed became lodged in his intestines, and thanks to their skill and compassion, our boy is now home and doing well.

Thank you for loving and caring for Goose like he was your own. We will never forget it. ❤️
Great service and very knowledgeable Doctor.

My cat got its eye scratched by another cat and it was swollen, bloody, and he was drooling profusely. They took him back right away to check him out and then sat me in a personal waiting room where I then filled out the forms. The doctor came out informing me on the injury and treatment they'd like to do. Then again to let me know the status as we waited and aftercare. All the staff there were kind, patient and friendly. I would go there again and recommend them to everyone. My cat is still in recovery as this happened a few days ago, but each day is better.
Dr Anderson and Maria were great, thank you for the excellent service!

An amazing knowledgeable staff. Specialized in veterinary surgical procedures but a full service veterinary. The Dr. took his time explaining everything thoroughly. He did not leave until HE was satisfied we understood. Highly recommend!

I’m beyond grateful to Dr. Andrade and her incredible team for saving Odin’s life.  The compassion, skill, and extraordinary support shown by Dr. Andrade, Matty, Matt, and every member of the staff went far beyond anything we could have expected. The way they cared for both our dog and our family should be required training for every veterinary hospital. You are all truly the absolute best.  Thank you.

The only place I trust my babies with! The Nurses and the Doctors are all very knowledgeable. I've been here all weekend with Nurse Lucy and Harold and they have been wonderful along with Dr. Anderson, Dr. Andrade the best surgeon, and Dr. Maria Wenzl. So kind and professional all at the same time.
Excellent service

The service here was exceptional. Dr Anderson was very thorough and kind. Tabitha and Harol D also made the experience for my Goldendoodle great. I will definitely be back. This was my first time here and i felt very comfortable and trusted them with my dog.

I cannot say enough good things about MVS and Dr. Andrade’s team.

I’ve brought my senior dog here twice for complicated surgical and specialty care and both experiences have been exceptional, especially considering how emotional and stressful these situations are. My dog is truly like my child and my whole world. I previously worked in veterinary medicine and I’m very particular about who I trust with his care, especially after moving from Canada and having to find a new medical team for my senior boy.

Dr. Andrade and her team have provided some of the best veterinary care I’ve experienced. Not only is she knowledgeable and compassionate, but when I mentioned I wasn’t happy with my general vet, she even took the time to recommend a local clinic that was a great fit.

A special thank you to Matty and Mathew (the RVTs) who are both fantastic! Our anxious dog genuinely trusts them, and they always communicate clearly and kindly, which makes a difficult experience feel much easier.

Long waits have never been an issue, (honestly been refreshing compared to many emergency and specialty hospitals!). The clinic is clean, well run and even smells pleasant. Every staff member we’ve interacted with has been professional, caring, and helpful.

Most importantly… I truly trust MVS with my dog, even when I’m worried care is complex or high stakes. Highly recommend!
I am very, very satisfied with the result we have achieved with my pet, thanks to this wonderful group. Many blessings to all the team members, thank you so much 🙏
Took my dog for a surgery. All went well. Exceptional attention from Matty and Dr. Andrade.

3 months ago my small dog was bitten and put in critical condition,  I brought to 2 other vet hospital that perform surgery that never held up and only got worse, after relapse I brought back to VEG hospital that then told me there’s nothing they could do from that point and that my dog had no chance of living and I should put him down. I decided to take my chance and bring to MVS, and thankfully I did, DR. Nandrade Saved my dog’s life. They showed so much care even before surgery calling and checking as they knew how critical he was and could stop breathing, when I was concern I brought in and  they kept overnight and gave around the clock care and perform surgery immediately next morning. I’m beyond greatful, today my pet is even more playful and slowly recovering and going back to normal

This place is highly appreciated and recommended.   My dog had emergency and wa treated as soon as we got there.  Dr. Anderson was very understanding very professional and knowledgeable.   His assistant Keilyn was very professional and caring.  I would highly recommend this animal hospital.  👌
DR ANDERSON WAS GREAT. EXPLAINED EVERYTHING AND NURSE KEILYN WAS VERY PROFESIONAL AS WELL. THE WHOLE STAFF WAS WONDERFUL. HIGHLY REMCOMEND
We are so happy with this service thank you so much!! Dr Anderson, Jackie, herold, and Keilyn were all amazing! We will defiently come back if ever needed🤍 …
I just want to say thank you Dr. Anderson for supporting us and such a tender time. Thank you.

I was referred here by my vet, and the experience has been excellent from start to finish. The staff is kind, attentive, and genuinely cares about their patients. I’m very grateful for the level of care my baby received. Dr. Andrade took the time to be thorough and compassionate, and I felt completely comfortable trusting her with my 11-year-old Yorkie. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a team that truly cares.

Dr. Ben Anderson is an amazing veterinarian. I brought my 4 month kitten here due to excessive throw up. Dr. Anderson was very detailed of the exams that were being performed on my kitten. He explained these exams will check for heart worm or anything in the kitten gut that maybe be causing him to throw up. Harold who is a CVT in the hospital was extremely helpful and nice since we arrived and was making sure I was ok and checked on my kitten. Harold was also helpful when it came to the treatment payment plan and worked with me on the bill knowing my financial circumstances. I would highly recommend for any  emergency vet for your pet, this is the place to bring them. They are a fantastic team, and care for the health of your pet.

Wish I could put 6 Stars or more !

Unfortunately, our Frenchie, Tank … is a frequent guest at Miami Veterinary Specialists.

He’s always getting into trouble !

Tonight, he came across a cane toad in our backyard just 15’ away from my wife n I as we sat outside enjoying the evening. We saw him come out from behind our outdoor furniture spiting and foaming at the mouth. Though we flushed his mouth within seconds, he was still foaming at the mouth as we rushed him to the 24-hr facility.

The staff and the doctors at Miami Vetinary are apparently trained to keep calm, and react fast to emergencies. The young lady at the reception desk called another young lady Keilyn, whom I suppose is a nurse and in less than 90 seconds took Tank back into the examination room, where I Dr Anderson was.

We received an update from Keilyn about 8-10 minutes later that his temperature shot up, but otherwise seemed fine. They were keeping him for observation to make sure he was stable.

They directed us into a more private room to wait for the doctor, who came out another 8-10 minutes later to tell us that Tank would be fine. Apparently we caught and reacted quick enough that Tank didn’t have time to ingest much of the poison.

Thank god. He is our kid, just as any other family member !

Keilyn brought him out to us about 5 minutes later, told us he’d be ok. Also told us that our fees that night were reduced to a minimal amount.

Again, these folks are top-notch, professional and care about our furry babies. We were in and out in record time in less than 30 minutes.

Thank you Dr Anderson m, Keilyn and the rest of the staff at MVS for all you did and do !

PS: Tank was put in time-out when we got home. lol 😂 No more running free, hunting lizards in the backyard. It’s rainy season and hence these venomous toads are out and about. Folks, keep your fur babies close to you when you’re outside …

Do not take your pet here. They are happy to take your $$$$ (lots of it lol) but when you ask for a simple favor, like approving an anti-tick topical, they will not help. I remember taking my dog there who was prescribed Metoclopramide at the time and he started to become very groggy as if he took Benadryl or something. I asked HIS VET WHO PRESCRIBED IT, if that was one of the side effects. Her response: "you're giving him something else, because Metoclopramide doesn't cause that." Of course I google it and found out sedation is a side effect. As a physician who prescribes medications every day, I was shocked the vet had no knowledge on its side effects and quite frankly a little fearful as she was the one performing the surgery on our dog. I advise choosing a specialist who is knowledgeable in the medications they are prescribing and kind enough to approve a simple topical request after you have spent nearly 6,000$. Thank god our dog is still alive.

Dr. Anderson and Nurse Harold were incredibly professional, funny, and sympathetic to the needs of my dog, Spanky. They consistently kept us informed as to the status and condition of Spanky and were very prompt in recommending an effective solution to his condition.
This is the best place to bring your sick pet during an emergency. Professional staff and the veterinary explain every details of your pet sickness.

I went to visit my pet around 11pm and when I walked in I immediately noticed the lack of cleanliness. There was flies everywhere, animal dishes piled high and when I was with my baby I noticed blood splatter and dried food on his cage door. The puppy next to him peed and when I told  the nurse she just rolled her eyes at me. Mind you there were more people but they were all in the corner on their phones. I didn't appreciate the lack of customer service or attention to detail, if you're a "professional" hospital you're staff needs to know how to properly accommodate and be on top of things that are dirty or hazardous to other animals health. I was recommended to come here by a friend who received services for her cat but I was sadly let down.
Dr. Anderson is one of a kind. He has treated my puppy 3 times and every visit he is compassionate, smart and I always felt like my furbaby was in good hands.

First of all let me just say I TRULY APPRECIATE ALLLLLL THE STAFF at MVS and I really would like to give a special thanks and a heartfelt warm review on Dr.Anderson. I came in this facility in desperate need for my kitty who had eaten some moldy food and was really sick. Something that happened unexpectedly and truly at a bad time. But Dr.Anderson was understanding and so helpful he did everything he needed to do to make sure my baby made it home in a better condition than he arrived. I have never been so appreciative and grateful. I owe this vet BIG TIME . Dr.Anderson THANK YOU! continue being a phenomenal Dr that truly loves being a stepping tool for these little beings! Lots of Hugs and lots of love for you and the whole staff. You were all so kind patient and very friendly! I love all of you and so does my baby STRUBBLE! God bless all of you and your families for an eternity
Professional staff, excellent care, thorough treatment, compassionate to owner needs and budget, runs on time, clean facilities like a human hospital, cannot recommend highly enough.

Everyone at the MVS hospital is always very attentive and kind. I’ve taken my dog AND cats here and they are always well taken care of. They are open 24 hours and always available to help. Thank you MVS hospital!
Dr Anderson and Melissa were amazing!!!

Dr Andrade operated on 2 of our dogs after hip dislocations. She and the entire team were wonderful from beginning to end. Empathetic, caring. Truly wanted the best outcomes. A year later, a vet at another ER (we temporarily moved) couldn’t believe our dog had his surgery, because he healed so well. Can’t recommend highly enough.

BEST PLACE EVER!!!! If i can give more than 5 stars i would! From the moment we got there nurse Harold was extremely attentive and my dog was taken in immediately. They examined my dog with care and once completed Dr. Anderson and nurse Harold explained the issue and were both very patient. The staff really went above and beyond and i couldn't be more grateful to them for being amazing in a moment of distress. I can't recommend this place enough and would return if in need of medical assistance for any animals.
Thank you guys again!
Miriam Silva
Ivy Silva.
Wove you
🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞🐶🐾💞⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I want to thank veterinarian Dr. Ardenson and his entire team for the excellent care. Maria, Keilin, and Harold (the nurse) were incredibly kind, professional, and attentive at all times. It's clear they truly love what they do and care for each pet as if it were their own. They patiently explained everything to me and made me feel at ease throughout the entire process. I wholeheartedly recommend them. Thank you for taking such good care of my dog ​​❤️🐶
A wonderful experience. Dr. Anderson was very caring, and Nurse Keylin was very attentive. I highly recommend the clinic.

I liked the service; my dog ​​swallowed a sock and in less than a minute, with the induced vomiting, he expelled it. It was all quick, thank God 😅 and they didn't charge me an arm and a leg like other clinics, thank you 🙏 …

Dr Ben Anderson.  First time emergency visit, I must say I had a great experience from the front desk as well as Dr and techs.  Very caring and explained everything.  Definitely recommend.  My fur baby is going to be fine..
This is a wonderful veterinarian. We had an emergency and came here and they treated us with such kindness. Maria was especially wonderful. I would completely recommend this place to anyway!
thank you so much Dr Anderson for your great service. Recommended 100%

Grateful for the service and caring way my dog and I were received and immediately attended to by Harold. Thank you Dr. Anderson for your evaluation and attention to my precious Mya. We are glad to have had such quality care and we will sleep better tonight. Again thank you Dr Anderson you are the best!

Amazing experience  with my Lilybelle 🐶. It was a Sunday morning , and my 15 years old Chihuahua wasn't walking right, I brought her in and they saw her right away, Dr. Katerina was her vet doctor.  What an amazing human being, you can tell she  truly cares . She was honest and so kind. The prices are great. Truly highly  recommend this place for your pets . If you have an emergency, don't hesitate to bring them here.

Dr.Ivan Perez is amazing. He gave us hope when we thought there wasn't any. Our 4-month-old kitten "Snow" started showing symptoms of FIP, and Dr.Perez was quick to figure that out and treat him accordingly. Now our kitty is 1 week into their FIP medication and showing great progress. Thank you, Dr.Ivan Perez, for being kind, compassionate, and very professional.

THIS REVIEW ISN'T for the hospital staff specifically; the front desk was really kind and attentive. I believe the head doctor even came out to check on my pregnant beagle, though I felt he saw us as too inexperienced to handle a home birth. He suggested a link with info on home births, which I appreciate. However, I brought my dog in because she was shivering and curling into a fetal position as if she were having contractions. Since she is young, I initially suggested a C-section, but the doctor told me it was better to do a home birth because, and I quote, "vet clinics are normally dirty."

We waited for a veterinarian to perform an accurate check, which we understood, but this felt urgent as it is an emergency hospital and my dog was acting sick. Once we were in a room, the nurse took our info, but I honestly don't know what they actually did for her. When the doctor (I believe his name is Dr. Anderson) finally met with me, he scolded me for even bringing her in. He claimed she was only shivering because I was "stressing her out" and said he had more important things to deal with. He insisted my dog was NOT in labor.

Unfortunately, the next morning we woke up to find she had given birth to six puppies in her crate all on her own. I was in tears. Not only did she have to go through that alone after I was told it wasn't happening, but the doctor chose to take his anger out on a paying patient rather than doing his job. He even tried to claim she was only 7 months old to explain why the pregnancy was "hard," which was a lie—she is 11 months old. I decided to trust him when he said she wasn't in labor, but he was wrong. I am not affected by his harsh character, but lying about a dog's wellbeing should be reprimanded. It is truly unacceptable that the rating of this hospital suffers because of this kind of behavior.

Everyone here has been super helpful, polite, and have gone above and beyond to make sure our baby was well taken care of.  I can't thank our surgeon  and her team enough for everything they've done. Not only was the care there amazing, their post operation care has also been of high quality. I have no doubt putting my trust in them should the situation ever come up again.
Helped us figure out what was wrong with my dog in a reasonable time, but the price was a bit high.

Today I went through a heartbreaking experience and brought a small kitten to Miami Veterinary Specialists after it was hit by a car. Sadly, the kitten had already passed away.

Even in such a painful moment, their team treated me with incredible compassion, kindness, and respect. They helped me immediately, did not charge me for anything, including the body disposition, and showed genuine concern for my emotional well-being.

I am a nurse at Baptist, and I truly appreciate professionals who lead with empathy. I will never forget the humanity this team showed me in such a difficult moment. Thank you for the beautiful work you do for both animals and people

My dog ​​escaped under the fence and, unfortunately, was hit by a car. He arrived at Miami Veterinary Specialists (MVS) in very bad shape, and from the very first moment, the team treated me with great professionalism and clarity. They were honest at all times, explaining step by step what was happening, the treatment options, and what we could expect. It was clear they did their best: they performed the necessary procedures, stabilized him, and were able to heal him. Now he is recovering well at home, thanks to God and the excellent care he received there.

The staff was attentive, compassionate, and very efficient, even in such a serious emergency. Yes, it is a specialized hospital, and the costs are high (as with any serious emergency), but the quality of service, the specialists available 24/7, and the follow-up they provided are totally worth it when your best friend's life is at stake.
I loved it

MVS is a great place to bring your dog if you have an emergency. My dog tore his left CCL completely about 1.5 years ago. We moved 3 hours away, but still chose to take the drive because we knew Dr. Andrade & team would not disappoint. We called & told the front desk staff our situation. In less than 1 hour, Dr. Andrade's tech called me, gave me a consult appt & TPLO surgery appt for the same day, taking into consideration our long drive. They took excellent care of our baby & now he is on his way to a full recovery. I HIGHLY recommend this place, especially Dr. Andrade & her team.

We took our furrbaby at 11:30 Pm, doctor go to us by 2 AM, she visited us in a room. Very thorough with care and treatment plan. It helped my baby feel better. Thank you!

Took my baby Turrón in at the crack of dawn with what we thought was a simple upset stomach/nausea/dehydration. Harold & Dr. Anderson were attentive, informative and advised of plans of action. Thank you, Dr. Anderson for helping my cat eight. Came in tonight and was very worried and left feeling like we were able to get everything resolved with him. Thanks again.

MVS is the best hospital that I have been to. I came in with my baby dachshund and was extremely worried. From the moment we arrived, the staff was incredibly kind and supportive. The nurse, Keily, was amazing she helped us through everything and explained every step of the process so clearly.

Dr. Anderson was also incredible. Throughout the entire process, he took the time to explain what was happening and made sure we understood our options. Thanks to Dr. Anderson, Keily, and the entire MVS staff, our little girl is now at home wagging her tail. We are so grateful for the care, kindness, and dedication they showed to our family and our dog. I can’t thank them enough.
Amazing service, they helped our dog so much they gave her everything needed to survive, special thank you to Dr.German, dr. Bruggeman, Nicole and jazmin

I can’t say enough good things about MVS Hospital. A solid 10/10. From the second we walked in, everything was seamless. they got my dog in and taken care of quickly.

The front desk made us feel welcome right away, Harold the vet tech kept me in the loop the whole time, Keylin the nurse was fantastic during the assessment, and Dr. Ben Anderson was exactly the kind of doctor you hope for. He was quick, caring, and very knowledgeable.

And because they were so quick about the care the cost of the emergency vet visit was completely reasonable.
Thank you to Dr. Benjamin Anderson. He helped me out with my puppy Canelo. I extremely recomend his service for all your pets needs.

Honey Bear needed Hyperbaric Chamber Therapy to treat a nasty pythiosis infection. The staff are one of the friendliest I've ever met in a vet's office and I've been going to veterinarians for well over 50 years. Thank you so much for the great experience.
Super delighted 🙌❤️🐾 …

I want to share my experience so far, after having been to multiple veterinary clinics such as VCA, Brickell Bay Animal Hospital, Red Bird Animal Hospital, and a few others in Kendall... where all the vets told me that Lola's problem, my dog, was unsolvable and that she had dementia... but it seemed too strange to me since the problem started suddenly; she would walk in circles, bump into things, cry in pain, and the only explanation was that she was old (Lola is 11 years old). I finally came here to Dr. Larin. During the consultation, we talked, and I told him everything that was happening and how strange it seemed that our dog, who had been quite healthy, had suddenly become like this. Upon examining her, he noticed that Lola cried when he touched her spine and prescribed a three-week course of steroids. Lola literally came back down to earth. She stopped circling, couldn't walk, got lost in the house, and cried. The doctor recommended a CT scan to check if any nerves in her spine were damaged or if something else could be causing this, which we thought was a brilliant idea. She's having the procedure today, and we hope to soon understand what's wrong with Lola. I'm so grateful we followed our instinct to insist on finding out what's wrong with Lola and that we met this doctor who clearly knows his stuff. It's incredible that for five months no veterinarian even attempted to find the cause or suggest any tests. I highly recommend them!

🐶 Emergency! Miami Veterinary Specialists = life-saving pros 🩺… with a side of chaos 💸😅. Long waits ⏳, confusing bills, and hit-or-miss service 😬. Your fur-baby might be fine, your wallet… not so much 💔. Only go if it’s a real crisis 🚨⚡. …

We had to take our dog to this emergency veterinary center, and we are truly grateful for the care we received. From the very beginning, Dr. Harold and Dr. Anderson were incredibly empathetic, kind, and human.

They took the time to listen to us, explain everything calmly, and made us feel supported during a very stressful and emotional moment. You can tell when someone is not only highly professional, but genuinely cares.

Thank you for the warmth, compassion, and respect you showed us and our dog. We highly recommend this place.
Jarol and Dr. Anderson provided excellent care. Our dog left happy, and my wife and I were delighted.

We brought a stray cat that was hurt and needed medical attention. Dr. Anderson was very thorough and gave us detailed information on our options. The staff was also very supportive. We highly recommend MVS Hospital for their professionalism and kindness.

My 14yr-old dog, Lucky, tore his right ACL last year and Dr. Andrade and her team did a phenomenal job. He ended up tearing his other left ACL earlier last week so we're back at MVS for his second surgery, but feel reassured knowing that Dr. Andrade will be performing his surgery again and that he is in good hands. Everyone at MVS has been nothing short of exceptional from the front desk staff to the medical techs. Highly recommend this place for orthopedic surgery!

Our family has experienced one of the most difficult moments of our lives with the passing of our beloved Hannah. From the very first moment her cancer treatment began, we felt the compassion and empathy shown by the entire staff.
Dr. Suter was excellent throughout the chemotherapy process, and Hannah's final moments in Dr. Carles's care were incredibly comforting for us.
A thousand thanks to the entire staff for their loving care of Hannah.

The doctors are extremely professional and truly know what they are doing. If you need an accurate diagnosis—especially in emergency situations—this is the place to go. The real issue, however, is the front desk staff. The people who greet you in person and those who answer the phone are consistently extremely rude and lacking empathy. They do not seem to care about you as a person or about pets as living beings who are suffering. This is not an isolated incident—I have two dogs and have been dealing with this clinic for over three years, and unfortunately, the experience is always the same.

They are dealing with people who are often in stressful, emotional, and difficult situations. The way clients are treated leaves a lot to be desired. Management should seriously address this and provide proper training in empathy and emotional intelligence for their reception staff

We are very satisfied with the care our pet Mini received from the entire team, and especially from Daniela, for her professionalism, patience, and love. We are very grateful, and it gives us peace of mind to know that there is empathetic staff available when needed. Thank you all...Ramona and Raúl.

I would like to express my gratitude to Dr. Carles Canyamas and the staff at Miami Veterinary Specialists. We took our dog to MVS last week as he was very sick, and Dr. Canyamas treated him. Thank you for all your support Dr. Canyamas. Highly recommend MVS.
Couldn’t have asked for better care of my 4 legged son in his last few hours. Highly recommend them, especially Dr Canyamas!
They provide excellent service, helped us make the best decision for our pet, and were attentive at all times. I highly recommend them.

The attention was immediate, and they explained each procedure and medication. The doctor came every 20 minutes or so to tell us how I was recovering. I recommend them 100%.

Miami Veterinary Specialists has been nothing short of incredible for our family. The vet techs here are absolutely amazing—every visit feels personal, and they treat our two Bully Breed dogs like their own.

Between Dr. Andrade’s expertise and the compassionate staff, every experience at MVS has been filled with care, love, and real results. We’re beyond grateful for everything they’ve done for our babies. Highly recommended!

These people are nice and helpful. The Doctors were super nice. it is 24/7 emergency care so prices are a little higher.  They were nicer than some of the other Vet offices in this area.

I was just caught in a situation where my family was in vacation and I was taking care of my niece Coco , Daniela was our angel , she is not only professional but very compassionate  with everybody and the pets , I’m so thankful to all personal but especially to Daniela , thanks for everything .❤️❤️

I can’t thank Dr. Andrade and the entire team enough for the incredible care they’ve given to my dog, Oliver, over the past few weeks. From the moment we walked in, we were met with warmth, kindness, and true professionalism.

Every staff member has been attentive, honest, and genuinely dedicated. Oliver means the world to me, and knowing he’s in such capable and compassionate hands gives me real peace of mind.

Highly recommend this clinic to any pet parent looking for top-notch care. Thank you again!
Great place, staff is well trained and great people

We brought our 8-year-old  English Bulldog to this emergency vet showing clear signs of serious distress—what we now understand were end-of-life symptoms. As hopeful pet parents, we held on to the chance it might be an infection. Unfortunately, the vet on call failed to be transparent with us about how critical his condition really was. Instead of preparing us for the real possibility that this could be his last night, we were sent home—only to receive a devastating call the next morning that our beloved dog had gone into cardiac arrest.

The emotional toll was enormous, but the handling of everything afterward only made it worse. This was our first time losing a pet, and no one explained the cremation process or the difference between private and communal cremation. We were not given a choice or a clear explanation—and because of that, we now have no dog and no ashes. No opportunity for closure, no way to bring him home.

We also paid a significant amount of money for care that felt cold, rushed, and ultimately lacking the empathy and communication we so desperately needed in that moment.

Pet parents deserve honest, clear guidance and compassionate care during such critical moments—not false hope and silence. We trusted this place with our dog’s final hours and were left feeling heartbroken, confused, and unsupported. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone facing an emergency with their pet.

Dropping off a pet for a friend.  The front desk staff were very nice. Dr. Mears technician Gabriel explained everything so I could tell the owners what to expect for this procedure.  Office was clean. Wait times were reasonable.

I want to start this review by saying I was devastated when I found out my two year old cat had a fractured femur and needed an operation. They were willing to assist with all my questions and I had a LOT of them. Secondly Dr Andrade is the most incredible, communicative and kind surgeon she treated us and my fur baby with the utmost respect and care. Dr Andrade goes ABOVE and BEYOND to ensure your pet receives the utmost care. 10/10!!! Dr Andrade was extremely communicative throughout and answered any and all questions no matter how trivial. Lastly Mattie is absolutely amazing, he could not do enough to make sure my cat was well taken care of, and also answered any and all of my concerns. Mattie truly cares about your pet, and I couldn’t have left my cat in better hands. If you are looking for a place where your animal will be taken care of home away from home this is THE place. A huge thank you to Dr Andrade, Mattie and the rest of the team you are all incredible!!!
They are great! I love Dr. Anderson!

From the first call to MVS the person was very caring and proficient in providing instructions on taking my kitty Hercules. When I arrived the staff already had everything set up for us and made it a simple process for us to get him well.

Everything was SPOTLESS and organized, I am the type of person who looks at details and want Hercules to be treated in the best way possible and MVS sure did it for us! He’s been home and happier than before ever since his visit

I advise against taking your pet to MVS due to impersonal treatment and exorbitant pricing.

My very ill dog needed hospitalization.They presented a shockingly high initial budget with a long list of tests. The nurse assigned to us upon arrival was rude and impatient when I questioned the cost and asked for clarification.

Some personnel seemed more concerned with maximizing charges than providing compassionate care.

Unfortunately, I absolutely do not recommend this clinic. In my case, I took my dog ​​there on a Saturday for a consultation, to repeat his ultrasound, and to establish a treatment plan. I brought the records from his previous ultrasound (performed at the end of October) and all his previous tests and treatments. They offered us a very expensive plan before even performing the ultrasound or any other tests. We had to keep him hospitalized (they weren't flexible about taking him directly for the ultrasound the next day) while we waited for the ultrasound, which was supposed to be done on Sunday but couldn't be performed. As a result, he ended up staying hospitalized until Tuesday due to other issues as well (such as low oxygen levels). In the end, the doctor simply called me to ask when we were going to pick him up, informing me that his prognosis was very poor (a few months), and prescribing the same pills previously prescribed by the cardiologist, but with more inconvenient appointment times. In short, the entire supposed "plan" before we got the new results was just a way to charge us. Even on Tuesday, when I went to pick him up, they still hadn't properly reduced his oxygen, knowing we were coming to get him and keeping him at the clinic 24/7. Today, I received a follow-up call about a bad review that wasn't even mine. With the whole situation, I didn't even want to waste my time writing a bad review. However, I decided to share my experience because I know how painful it is to go through such a sad and desperate situation. In conclusion: I find the clinic very expensive and the communication terrible. If you're looking for a place that truly cares about your pet's well-being and medical needs, don't go to this clinic. They'll just present you with bills and completely unnecessary "work plans" only to tell you what you already knew, or worse, just to make money in the end.

I took my dog to the emergency room due to lethargy and muscle spasms. The veterinarian strongly recommended lab work and X-rays. The lab results showed elevated potassium, and the doctor strongly advised hospital admission. However, due to financial constraints, I decided to take my dog home against medical advice (AMA), though I was made to feel guilty about my decision. Later that evening, I returned to admit my dog for further treatment because I wanted to do the right thing. The next morning, I was informed that my dog’s potassium levels had normalized quickly and that sometimes high readings can occur due to lab errors. This was incredibly frustrating, especially after spending $2,000 on treatment for no reason, as my dog doesn’t have insurance. We need more compassionate and considerate doctors who prioritize accurate diagnoses and take financial concerns into account.

I took my dog to MVS because she wasn’t peeing properly for a few days, and we were concerned about a UTI or potential bladder stones, as she had surgery for this in the past. Initially, a nurse came in, asked all the necessary questions, and provided us with a quote for X-rays and a catheter to release her urine. However, when the doctor came in, things quickly took a turn.

Within less than two minutes, the doctor performed an ultrasound and gave us a devastating diagnosis, claiming with 90% certainty that our dog had advanced cancer and wouldn’t survive the fight. My girlfriend and I were heartbroken, confused, and traumatized—especially since she had been eating and acting normal. The doctor even appeared to be recording the conversation while giving us this diagnosis his phone had volume and it was heard when he started recording , which felt very inappropriate. Shortly after, he came back into the room with a smirk, saying he performed the ultrasound from a different angle and now realized he had mistaken and it was “50/50” between cancer and bladder stones.

This emotional rollercoaster completely broke us. I even had a panic attack in the waiting room. For three days, we were devastated, believing our dog could’ve had terminal cancer.

Thankfully, there was a shift change, and the new vet took over. He immediately reassessed the situation, explained what needed to be done, and finally performed the X-rays and catheterization. It turned out our dog had bladder stones, not cancer, and she required surgery.

We are incredibly thankful for the surgical team who performed her surgery and helped her recover. Our baby is alive and doing well, thank God.

The only bad experience we had here was with the initial doctor, whose rushed and overly confident diagnosis caused us so much unnecessary trauma. I would urge the clinic to ensure diagnoses are handled with more care, especially for such serious matters. We deeply appreciate the second vet , the customer service team who answered every question when we would check in her after surgery and the surgical team for providing our dog with the proper care and compassion she needed.
Good but very very very expensive!
